anchor_value: USD cost; EUR/AUD apply only to par

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Hamilton Thorne, Inc. | ... | EUR | 11,492 | 12,331 | 13,017; EUR is in Par/Shares, while 12,331 is Cost.
Sonar Acquisitionco, Inc. (dba SimPRO) | ... | AUD | 5,600 | 3,688 | 3,825; AUD is in Par/Shares, while 3,688 is Cost.
Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars (USD) unless otherwise noted, Australian Dollars (AUD), or Euros (EUR).

findings.detail: Hamilton Thorne cost_currency incorrectly inherited EUR from the adjacent Par/Shares currency field.
Sonar Acquisitionco cost_currency incorrectly inherited AUD from the adjacent Par/Shares currency field.

rationale: The schedule places EUR and AUD in the Par/Shares currency position, not in Cost. Footnote (4) confirms that these currency labels describe par amounts. The two FX03 rows therefore reflect a pipeline column-context leak into cost_currency; the reported cost figures remain in the schedule's USD-denominated Cost column.
